description.la: Allegorica expositio in Cantica canticorum libri septem.
description.en-US: Bede's seven-book allegorical commentary on the Song of Songs, the Church's voice to Christ: book I answers Julian of Eclanum, book VII is an anthology of Gregory the Great. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: O comentário alegórico de Beda ao Cântico dos Cânticos, em sete livros, como voz da Igreja a Cristo: o livro I responde a Juliano de Eclano e o livro VII é uma antologia de Gregório Magno.

sources.edition: Allegorica expositio in Cantica canticorum on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
